title: City Hall Rotunda
purpose: Civic sector card and municipal-identity surfaces.
story: The rotunda of a city hall at night — the symbolic heart of civic life, its marble silent under a single light.
environment: A circular rotunda interior, a mosaic floor beneath a ringed gallery, arched openings leading off into shadow.
architecture: Civic baroque interior — paired columns ringing the drum, a balustraded gallery, arched portals beneath a dim cupola.
composition: The circular floor centred and symmetrical, a warm light falling across the mosaic, the ringed gallery rising into negative space.
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade with one warm source and brass-on-black palette consistent with scene-01.
